name: Ayatsuji Tsukasa
source:
Class 2-A's class representative, who is both a hard worker and a person who is willing to take on any task that no one else will. 

[spoiler]While she acts kind and friendly, it is actually a facade that secretly hides the real her, who is manipulative and cunning.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amagami]AniDB[/url]]
